cross_verification.note_en: Directly browsed Nepal's Department of Immigration official site (immigration.gov.np/visa-fees-and-documents), which publishes a full 'Nepal Visa Types & Requirements' table covering Diplomatic, Official, Tourist, Working, Press, Relation, Marriage, Study, Business, NRN, Residential, Transit, and Reciprocity (US) visa categories with their required-document lists. None of these official lists itemize a photograph as a required document, so no photo-spec fields could be verified. Also checked the Tribhuvan International Airport Immigration Office's official FAQ (tia.immigration.gov.np/faq), whose 6 published questions do not cover photo requirements either. Third-party sources claim figures like 1.5"×1.5" for online tourist e-visa uploads, but this was not confirmed on an official .gov.np page and is excluded here.
